spl.name: Q-PRIVACY-CANDIDATES.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.lab.id"="LAB-PRIVACY-DATA-GOVERNANCE-001" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision "agentsec.control.id"="CTRL-MCP-001"
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval data_preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval data_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| table _time, run_id, mode, tool, decision, reason, data_preview, data_hash
| sort 0 _time

spl.name: Q-PRIVACY-TRACE.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"=__RUN_ID__
| eval sequence=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval boundary=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.trust_boundary'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval data_preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval data_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table sequence, _time, event_name, boundary, tool, decision, reason, data_preview, data_hash, attempted, executed, outcome
| sort 0 sequence

spl.name: Q-PRIVACY-COMPARE.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 ("agentsec.run.id"=__FULL_RUN_ID__ OR "agentsec.run.id"=__MINIMIZED_RUN_ID__) ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval decision=if('event.name'="agentsec.control.decision",'agentsec.control.decision',null())
| eval reason=if('event.name'="agentsec.control.decision",'agentsec.control.reason',null())
| eval request_preview=if('event.name'="agentsec.control.decision",'agentsec.content.preview',null())
| eval request_hash=if('event.name'="agentsec.control.decision",'agentsec.content.hash',null())
| eval completion_preview=if('event.name'="agentsec.mcp.completed",'agentsec.content.preview',null())
| eval completed=if('event.name'="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| stats values(mode) AS mode values(decision) AS decision values(reason) AS reason values(request_preview) AS request_preview values(request_hash) AS request_hash max(completed) AS completed values(completion_preview) AS completion_preview BY run_id
| eval additional_field_marker=if(match(request_preview,"account_balance_band"),"OBSERVED IN PREVIEW","NOT OBSERVED IN PREVIEW")
| table mode, run_id, decision, reason, completed, additional_field_marker, request_preview, request_hash, completion_preview
| sort 0 mode
